# Both engines have to import PyMySQL to reach the modules' connection-
# failure wrappers at all (the module bootstrap's own driver gate). The
# capture harness pins the pinned ansible-core's site-packages on PYTHONPATH;
# on this box PyMySQL lives in that same user site-packages, which the
# replay's scratch HOME hides, so the replay's driver probe would otherwise
# report the driver missing. Pin the tree the capture used - a PYTHONPATH
# entry that does not exist is ignored by Python, so a host with PyMySQL in a
# system directory (CI installs python3-pymysql) replays this unchanged.
PYTHONPATH=/home/labros/.local/lib/python3.13/site-packages
# ansible.mysql's modules import to_native from the deprecated
# ansible.module_utils._text shim, so real prints a deprecation warning krikri
# (no Python module) can never reproduce, and the short module names resolve
# through community.mysql's redirect table with a deprecation of their own.
# Neither is part of the message this case pins; the same setting silences
# both engines (see 1660).
ANSIBLE_DEPRECATION_WARNINGS=False
